blockingIssues.description: xAI model-capability cache keys are not user-scoped in the per-user discovery path, so one user's discovered model catalog can be served to another user when endpoint names match.
SetKeyDialog legacy Azure saved payloads are not decoded by parseSavedFormValues, causing existing users to see raw JSON in the API key field instead of editable persisted values on reopen.
Realtime model-access validation rejects restricted xAI/custom session starts when model is omitted, even though broker/provider resolution still supports omitted-model fallback for those providers.
ScheduledRuns UI test coverage does not assert notification-settings save payload/persistence behavior despite claiming VAL-SCHED-002 protection.
ScheduledRuns UI tests do not exercise browser push subscribe/unsubscribe click flows or mutation calls, leaving VAL-SCHED-009 lifecycle behavior unpinned.
